description: Config file for email-backup-tool. See https://email-backup-tool.cyberjake.xyz/ for full documentation.

encrypt.description: Stage 2: the public key mail is encrypted to. Omit to store mail unencrypted.

public_key_file.description: Path to a local age or OpenPGP public key file. Set at most one of public_key_file, public_key_string and public_key_fingerprint.

public_key_fingerprint.description: Full 40-hex-digit v4 OpenPGP fingerprint to fetch from public_key_server. Spaces are ignored.

public_key_server.description: Keyserver host public_key_fingerprint is looked up on. Requires public_key_fingerprint.

public_key_string.description: An age or armoured OpenPGP public key, given inline.

login.description: Stage 1: where the mail is downloaded from.

imap.description: The IMAP server mail is fetched from.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to a CA certificate to verify the server, in place of the system trust store.

ignore_server_cert.description: Disable verification of the server certificate.

mailbox.description: Mailbox to back up. Defaults to every mailbox.

tls.description: How to establish TLS with the server.

save.description: Stage 3: where mail is stored. Set as many destinations as you want.

local.description: Save mail to a directory on disk.

s3.description: Save mail to an S3-compatible bucket.

access_key_id.description: Access key ID. Omit to use the ambient AWS configuration.

endpoint.description: URL of an S3-compatible service. Omit for AWS.

prefix.description: Key prefix applied to every uploaded object.

region.description: AWS region the bucket is in.

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key. Omit to use the ambient AWS configuration.

tar.description: Save mail into a tar archive.

path.description: Path of the tar archive to write.

version.description: Config schema version. Selects which fields the rest of the document is validated against.

title: email-backup-tool config file
